name: 54650 · Onalaska, WI
findings: ZIP 54650 (Onalaska) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54650 (Onalaska) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
